title: Lychee: Certified Screening of Inverted Lists for High-Recall Vector Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.30697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nearest-neighbor search over embedding vectors matches faces against watchlists, transactions against known fraud patterns, and medical images against confirmed cases, where a missed neighbor is a missed threat, fraud, or diagnosis. Because an approximate index cannot report which queries lost a true neighbor, these applications require recall of 0.999 to 0.9999, at a cost far below that of exact search over billions of vectors. Inverted-file indexes reach high recall by probing more lists, but they read and score every probed vector at full precision, so that throughput falls in inverse proportion to the number of probed lists. Graph indexes saturate below these targets, whereas quantized lists must rerank their candidates with the full vectors. Our insight is to decide for almost every probed vector that it cannot enter the top k of the probed lists without reading the vector, through the certified lower bound of exact search by certif

translated_title: Lychee：面向高召回率向量搜索的倒排列表认证筛选
translated_abstract: 对嵌入向量的最近邻搜索将人脸与监控名单、交易与已知欺诈模式、医学影像与确诊病例进行匹配，在这些应用中，漏掉一个近邻就意味着漏掉一个威胁、一起欺诈或一个诊断。由于近似索引无法报告哪些查询丢失了真实的近邻，这些应用要求召回率达到0.999至0.9999，同时成本远低于对数十亿向量进行精确搜索。倒排文件索引通过探测更多列表来达到高召回率，但它们需要以全精度读取并为每个被探测的向量评分，因此吞吐量与被探测列表的数量成反比下降。图索引在未达到这些目标之前就已饱和，而量化列表则必须使用完整向量对其候选进行重排序。我们的洞见是，借助精确搜索的认证下界，无需读取向量即可判定几乎每个被探测的向量都无法进入被探测列表的前k名……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Lychee方法，利用精确搜索的认证下界在无需读取向量的前提下筛除绝大多数被探测的向量，以远低于全精度评分的成本实现0.999以上召回率的高效最近邻搜索。
en_tdlr: Lychee uses certified lower bounds from exact search to screen out almost every probed vector without reading it, enabling nearest-neighbor search with 0.999+ recall at a fraction of the cost of full-precision scoring.
